author: Karl Rock
description:
Imagine wanting to see one of the world's most significant archaeological sites, but a border stands in your way. For many Indians, the ancient city of Mohenjo Daro is a bucket list destination that feels just out of reach due to visa restrictions.

This creates a unique and heartwarming service for those who can access the site. Irshad offers Indians free two hour virtual group tours of the ruins via video call. It is a way to bridge a gap, allowing people to walk through history through someone else's lens.

The experience is deeply personal, especially given that many people in Pakistan have family or relatives across the border who are unable to visit in person. It turns a simple tour into a meaningful connection, proving that curiosity and history can sometimes transcend even the strictest political boundaries.
title: A Pakistani’s FREE Service for Indians
